_template: SoftwareApplication / WebApplication (+ offers) — calculators and reviewed software (invoicing, clearing, CRM, payroll).
_inputs: offers (only when a real published price exists)
_notes: Emit `offers` ONLY where an accurate published price exists in /data/providers/*.json. Where pricing is 'quote_only', omit offers entirely (do not invent a price).
For provider review pages that are articles, prefer BlogPosting; add SoftwareApplication only as a secondary typed entity when the page genuinely reviews a software product.
Never attach aggregateRating (no first-party ratings are displayed).
